text: 13.3 1 What was the weather like in Peru? Was it hot? No, it wasn't actually. We arrived at night and it was freezing. Then, during the day, it was still chilly and cloudy. Oh dear! I wish I'd taken some warmer clothes. I only had t-shirts and one thin jacket. Oh no! It was stupid. I should have thought more carefully about what to pack. I knew we'd be in the mountains and could have checked the forecast. I guess, but South America? You assume it'll be hot. Exactly! It's silly, Deeley. Anyway, we still had an amazing time.
